description: Use to audit one YouTube video for search and AI visibility. Returns twelve checks against the video anchor model (metadata, chapters, captions and storyboard where observed), each naming what it read and whether it passed. Read-only; results are cached for six hours unless fresh is true. For a channel's upload list use video_channel; for how a website embeds its videos use video_site.
name: video_check
title: Check a video's SEO
